_note: Saved searches for the SEC filings listener (PRD E13-S1). NO prospect data lives here. Each search runs on EDGAR full-text search against the SEC filer IDs (CIKs) of every bank whose filer a principal has confirmed (outbound filers confirm). A search's phrases must ALL appear in one document. The endpoint has no proximity operator, so "near" can only mean "in the same document" (checked live 2026-11-13). Searches are AND-only on purpose: an "or" is written as two searches with their own ids, so each id is one exact query. 8-K item numbers are matched on each hit, never sent to the server, because its cache ignores them. Every search, window and code list here is a PLACEHOLDER for a principal to review.

searches.label: 8-K Item 2.01: an acquisition or disposition of assets completed
Loans transferred to held for sale, in a filing that mentions commercial real estate
Loans held for sale, in a filing that mentions commercial real estate (broad: a common balance-sheet line)
A loan sale, in a filing that mentions commercial real estate
A note sale, in a filing that mentions commercial real estate

proxies._note: Proxy statements of confirmed filers, recorded (form, date, link) for the briefer to read. No names are extracted: people fall under the contact rules (PRD E7). Each run looks back this far, so a newly confirmed filer gets its last proxy.

discovery._note: Finds bank filers NOT yet in the bank list: the searches below, by the filer's business-address state, kept only when the filer's SIC code is a bank code. Hits go to a for-review list (outbound filers discovered) and never become scored signals. The SIC codes are the SEC's depository-institution codes [verify the list with a principal].

suggest._note: outbound filers suggest: up to maxCandidates SEC entities per unmapped bank, each with its latest periodic filing (evidenceForms, within evidenceDays) as evidence of what it is. A principal confirms or rejects every one.

verify._note: outbound sources verify filings: the last run must have ended within freshDays (weekends included), and this many stored filings are searched for again.
